description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime indices, stock screener with technical signals, multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news, watchlist, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯、自选股、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA 叠加）、板块/涨停/龙虎榜榜单。
